hunks.baseline: Kim Junsu was a C-rank Hunter belonging to Sangdong Guild’s Security Team.
hunks.sol: Kim Junsu was a C-rank Hunter in Sangdong Guild’s Security Team.

hunks.baseline: He had not an ounce of talent for elemental magic, but fortunately, he had awakened as a rare type of mage—a mental mage—and was living a fairly successful life.
hunks.sol: He didn’t have an ounce of talent for elemental magic, but fortunately, he had awakened as a rare mental mage and was doing pretty well for himself.

hunks.baseline: *Except for the fact that I can’t go home.*
hunks.sol: *Except I can never go home.*

hunks.baseline: What good was owning a house larger than 330 square meters? As the only Familiar mage in Sangdong Guild, he never ran out of work.
hunks.sol: What good was owning a house of more than 330 square meters? As Sangdong Guild’s only Familiar mage, he never ran out of work.

hunks.baseline: Raid teams at least got to go home after running a Gate, but the Security Team had no such luxury. They had to spend every night in a different hideout.
hunks.sol: Raid teams at least got to go home after running a Gate. The Security Team had no such luxury. They spent their nights in one hideout after another.

hunks.baseline: A colleague on the Security Team clicked his tongue when he saw Kim Junsu’s hollowed-out face. He was the one person who had stayed behind to protect their valuable Familiar mage.
hunks.sol: A Security Team colleague clicked his tongue at Kim Junsu’s hollow-eyed face. He was the one person who had stayed behind to protect their valuable Familiar mage.

hunks.baseline: “You’re working hard. How does that bastard manage not to step outside even once?”
hunks.sol: “You’ve got it rough. How does that bastard not set one foot outside?”

hunks.baseline: “I know. We’ve been watching him for days, and he’s only gone out twice. Twice. Once to a real-estate office in Goyang and once to the Ilsan Store.”
hunks.sol: “Tell me about it. We’ve been watching him for days, and he’s only gone out twice. Twice. Once to a real-estate office in Goyang, and once to the Ilsan Store.”

hunks.baseline: “This is why it’s better when the target smokes. At least smokers come outside to have a cigarette.”
hunks.sol: “This is why smokers make better targets. At least they come outside for a cigarette.”

hunks.baseline: They had obtained a new cat to use as a Familiar and waited all night at the entrance of the apartment building, but the target had not budged.
hunks.sol: They had acquired a new cat to use as a Familiar and waited all night at the entrance to the apartment building, but the target hadn’t budged.

hunks.baseline: The only incident was when the cat, exhausted from waiting, started meowing and was nearly chased away by a security guard.
hunks.sol: The only incident had come when the cat, tired of waiting, started yowling and nearly got chased away by a security guard.

hunks.baseline: “Peace Guild? It looked pretty small. Do they even go on raids?”
hunks.sol: “Peace Guild? It looked pretty small. Don’t they go on raids?”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. A guy from Team 2 is watching the other members of Peace Guild, and apparently they’re all taking time off.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. A buddy of mine in Team 2 is watching the other Peace Guild members, and he said they’re all taking time off.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah… How’s that situation going?”
hunks.sol: “Ah… How are things going over there?”

hunks.baseline: “They pulled out yesterday. There was one woman and one middle-aged man, but it ended quickly. Judging by the Team Leader’s reaction, it seems like they turned up something over there, but I don’t know the details.”
hunks.sol: “They pulled out yesterday. The targets were a woman and a middle-aged man, and apparently it wrapped up pretty quickly. From the Team Leader’s reaction, it sounds like they found something, but I don’t know the details.”

hunks.baseline: “Phew. We should just do enough to get by and pull out, too.”
hunks.sol: “Phew. I wish we’d just do enough to get by and pull out too.”

hunks.baseline: His colleague looked at Kim Junsu with pity as he let out a deep sigh.
hunks.sol: His colleague gave Kim Junsu a pitying look as he heaved a deep sigh.

hunks.baseline: “There has to be a reason they specially assigned the Guild’s only Familiar mage, right?”
hunks.sol: “There must be a reason they specifically assigned the Guild’s only Familiar mage.”

hunks.baseline: “He’s still only a C-rank Hunter. Don’t you think this is going a little overboard?”
hunks.sol: “He’s still just a C-rank Hunter. Isn’t this a little excessive?”

hunks.baseline: “What can we do? When we’re told to do something, we have to do it. Even if the Team Leader hounds us like he did yesterday, we just have to put up with it.”
hunks.sol: “What can we do? When they say jump, we jump. If the Team Leader keeps riding you like he did yesterday, just put up with it.”

hunks.baseline: “He should hound us in moderation. This would’ve been over ages ago if he had just talked to that Hong Woojin guy and cooperated properly.”
hunks.sol: “He could stand to ease up. This would’ve been over ages ago if he’d talked things through with that Hong Woojin guy and cooperated properly.”

hunks.baseline: “He wants to show the Guild Master. ‘Our Security Team is much better than Hong Woojin. My leadership is this outstanding.’ Besides, it’s almost time for the second-half personnel reshuffle. No wonder the Team Leader is sweating bullets.”
hunks.sol: “He wants to show off for the Guild Master. ‘Our Security Team is far better than Hong Woojin. Look at my outstanding leadership.’ Besides, it’s almost time for the second-half personnel reshuffle. No wonder the Team Leader’s sweating bullets.”

hunks.baseline: “It is.”
hunks.sol: “Sure is.”

hunks.baseline: Kim Junsu wanted to tear his hair out, but he held himself back. If he did, the hair that had only just begun sprouting like fresh spring shoots might come right out.
hunks.sol: Kim Junsu wanted to tear his hair out, but he restrained himself. If he did, the hair that had only just begun sprouting like fresh spring shoots might come right out.

hunks.baseline: The doctor was a civilian who couldn’t even use the simple Light magic, but if he could give Kim Junsu a full head of hair, Junsu would worship him as Jesus.
hunks.sol: The doctor might be a civilian who couldn’t even cast the simplest Light spell, but if he could give Junsu a full head of hair, Junsu would worship him as Jesus.

hunks.sol: “That cat’s pretty affectionate. Is it yours, young man?”

hunks.sol: A man approached, dragging his slippers. He looked to be in his early forties, with an utterly ordinary face. His stretched-out T-shirt and soccer shorts stained with ramen broth gave him an approachable air.

hunks.sol: “I won’t be long. I’m just going to the real-estate office right over there.”

hunks.sol: “Really? Come to think of it, I haven’t seen you around before, young man. I’ve lived here a long time, so I know just about everyone. If you’re going to the real-estate office, are you moving into the neighborhood?”

hunks.sol: His last breath of smoke scattered in the wind. The man flicked his cigarette butt onto the ground and said, “Well, look at me, keeping a busy man. No hard feelings, right?”
